title: Early jobs on drums and piano with Louis Dumaine and Chris Kelly
summary: He took jobs on drums and piano with Louis Dumaine and Chris Kelly, and the interviewer compares notes on George Williams drumming with Kelly.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Chris Kelly, the blues trumpeter and his band

blocks.x: You took jobs on the drums too, I think?
Yeah, yeah, taking jobs on the drums, yeah.
Who'd you work with? Anybody that you know of?
Yeah, yeah. I don't know if you know him, but I work on drums with a fella by the name of Luis Domain, and I also work with him on piano.
Uh-huh, and I also work with Chris Kelly, one of them old times, you know. On drums and them? No, on piano. Yeah. I put the drums down there, because I got hired more on piano, you know what I mean?
George Williams said he worked with Chris on drums. Yeah, he did.
